aboutPreview.title:
The heart
of Riyadh.
aboutPreview.copy: Duset Hotel Suites is located in the heart of Riyadh — close to major shopping destinations in Riyadh: Al Nakheel Mall, Granada Market, Palm Market, Hayat Mall and the surrounding shops with eateries. Riyadh International Exhibition Center is a 5-minute drive away. The nearest airport, King Khalid Airport, is 23 km from the property. We are the providers of 71 luxury rooms with 24hrs service.

howItWorks.title:
Book your stay
in three steps.
howItWorks.subline: From browsing rooms to front-door welcome — reserving at Duset Hotel Suites is simple, secure and fast.

steps.title: Choose your room
steps.copy: Browse Deluxe Rooms, One Bed Room Apartments and two-bedroom suites — pick the space that fits your stay.

steps.title: Book in minutes
steps.copy: Reserve securely through our booking engine — no prepayment needed, with instant confirmation and proof of booking.

steps.title: Check in & unwind
steps.copy: Arrive from 10 AM, show your ID at reception and enjoy 24hrs service, free WiFi and room dining all day.
